[Your Name]

[City, State, ZIP]

[Landlord’s Name]

**Re: Immediate return of security deposit for [property address]**

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I am writing to demand the immediate return of my security deposit in the amount of [$X]. You have failed to return it within the legally required timeframe under [state] law, and I am done asking nicely.

I need you to understand something clearly: I am not going to let this go. I have already spoken with people who make it their business to make landlords’ lives extremely difficult when they break the law — a tenants’ rights attorney and investigators at the local housing authority. They are aware of your refusal to return my deposit, and they are ready to move forward the moment I give the word.

If I file the complaint that has already been prepared, you can expect formal investigations, administrative hearings, and legal action. Under [state] law, wrongfully withholding a security deposit can leave you liable for up to [two/three] times the deposit, plus court costs and attorney’s fees. Returning my deposit now will cost you [$X]. Fighting me will cost you far more — in money, time, and public record.

I am giving you one final opportunity to resolve this quietly. You have until [date, 7 days from today] to send the full deposit to the address above. If I do not receive it by then, I will let the people I have already contacted do what they do best. I assure you, that will make your life much harder than simply paying what you legally owe.

Govern yourself accordingly.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
